projects.title: Projects

f1.title: F1 Dashboard
f1.summary: A browser app to follow the Formula 1 season: next race, live session, standings, calendar and results.
f1.challenge: Bring together data from several F1 sources into a fast dashboard that looks good on any screen and updates itself, with no server to maintain.
highlights: Data from Jolpica and OpenF1 stored in a Cloudflare D1 database, refreshed every 10 minutes by a scheduled Worker.
Countdown to the next session, with a live state and the full weekend schedule.
Animated SVG circuit layouts, weather forecast and past winners.
Installable as an app (PWA), in Portuguese and English, fully keyboard accessible.
alts: Next race with countdown and circuit layout
Race results with times and laps
Session with podium and fastest laps

cuboguia.title: CuboGuia
cuboguia.summary: Tell it how your Rubik's cube looks, by painting the 3D model or using the camera, and get an animated step-by-step tutorial.
cuboguia.challenge: Teach people to solve several puzzles starting from the real state of their own cube, not a generic one.
highlights: Three.js 3D models for 2x2, 3x3, Pyraminx and Megaminx, with every turn animated.
Colour reading through the phone camera, or painting straight on the model.
Custom solvers: beginner method and CFOP for 3x3, optimal solution for 2x2 and Pyraminx.
Automated tests for the solver and colour reading with Vitest.
alts: CuboGuia home page with the 3D cube
Painting the cube colours on the 3D model
How it works: enter the colours, validate and follow the tutorial

buscafe.title: Buscafé
buscafe.summary: A Brazilian coffee comparison site: price, price per kg, price history, tasting notes, roast and origin from many roasters in one place.
buscafe.challenge: Turn the data gathered by the client's API and price scrapers into a fast, good-looking site that makes coffee easy to compare, so people choose by flavour and price rather than by the packaging.
highlights: Requirements gathered directly with the client to understand their pain points and what the site had to solve.
Catalogue with flavour, brew method, roast and region filters, search suggestions and side-by-side comparison shareable by link.
A page for every coffee with price history, cost per cup and structured data for Google.
Maps of producing regions and farms, a "Which coffee is for me?" quiz and coffee guides.
End-to-end tests with Playwright and continuous deployment to the client's server with Docker.
alts: Buscafé home page with search and catalogue figures
Coffee page with price, cost per cup and a link to the shop

apex.title: Apex Dev Studio
apex.summary: New website for my web development studio, focused on high-performance sites and SEO and GEO strategy.
apex.challenge: Show what the studio delivers using its own site as proof: fast, well ranked and with a strong identity.

about.title: About me
about.p1: I turn complex data into decisions and build applications that automate business routines. With a background in Mechanical Engineering and Systems Analysis, I work where Business Intelligence, data engineering and web development meet.
about.p2: I build end-to-end solutions: from extracting SAP data with Python to modelling and visualising it in Power BI. Outside data, I create web products from scratch, combining interface design and software architecture. I like shipping tools that take manual work off people's plates.
